podcast.body: This album was released in 2015, demonstrating continued musical activity for Limblifter into the mid-2010s. Ryan Dahle remained a key figure in the band after Kurt Dahle's departure. "But there was another Limlifter album in 2015 called Pacific Milk."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Lost CanRock Bands of the '90s: Part 1
